quality.review_scope: Independent scientific review of both supplied main pages, four figures, Table I and the six-reference bibliography passed without findings. One method supports seven partial size-labelled outcomes; exact per-size schedules and batches remain unresolved. SI and cited references remain unreviewed. Presentation refinements pending; no measured-coordinate admission.
missing_fields: Complete supplied two-page main only; any SI and all cited full references unreviewed.

Reagent masses, molar ratios, solution volumes/concentrations and PEG-solution solvent are not reported. PEG molecular weight is given as 20 000 without a distribution or specified molecular-weight average.
Dehydration/decomposition durations and atmospheres, calcination ramp/cooling and product workup are not reported.
The common 250–800 °C / 2–6 h range is not mapped to individual crystal-size outcomes; no seven exact thermal recipes or distinct physical batches are invented.
Average crystal size is evaluated by XRD and TEM, but no TEM image, morphology distribution, lattice parameter, refinement, unit-cell coordinates or exact specimen identifiers are supplied.
Magnetization and coercivity plots are retained without digitization. Figure 2 trace-to-sample assignments and Figure 4 symbol-to-size mapping are not resolved in the main.
Source-specific molecular, morphology and unit-cell presentation remain pending where a reliable reference or unique identity is not available.
conflicts: Figure 3 caption gives five lettered size labels, while the plotted graph shows unlabeled points; no transfer of these letters onto Figure 2 is assumed.
Figure 4 caption prints an anomalous Oe-to-A/m relation; no conversion of its Oe-axis values is performed.

The methods describe magnetic measurements from ambient temperature to 700 °C, while Figure 4 displays a 150–350 K range. These different source contexts are retained without an inferred low-temperature method.
